name: ProfitGate for WooCommerce
author: profitgate

sections.description:
Stop losing money to RTO (Return to Origin). ProfitGate acts as an intelligent gatekeeper for your WooCommerce checkout, analyzing every order to ensure it meets your profitability and risk standards.

Key Features:

  • Intelligent Risk Evaluation: Analyzes order telemetry to identify high-risk shoppers and fake COD attempts.
  • Commitment Verification: Automatically triggers OTP or manual verification for suspicious orders, ensuring only committed buyers proceed.
  • Silent Handshake: Seamlessly connects your store to the ProfitGate Intelligence Gateway.
  • Dynamic Margin Protection: Calculates RTO impact in real-time to protect your fulfillment costs.
  • Centralized Hub: Manage your store portfolio, adjust thresholds, and monitor performance from the ProfitGate Merchant Hub.

External Services

This plugin connects to the ProfitGate Intelligence Gateway (https://profitgate.ai) to evaluate order risk and synchronize order status.

The external service is required for the plugin’s risk evaluation and margin protection functionality.

Data transmitted may include:

  • Customer first and last name
  • Customer email address
  • Customer phone number
  • Billing city, state, postcode, and country
  • Customer IP address
  • Customer user agent
  • Order total and currency
  • Cart items (including SKU, quantity, and product categories)
  • Payment method
  • Order ID (for status synchronization)

All data is transmitted securely via HTTPS and authenticated using HMAC-SHA256 signatures.

No remote code is executed on the WordPress site.

Privacy Policy:
https://profitgate.ai/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the profitgate-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to ProfitGate in your WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Click Go to Merchant Hub to link your store and generate your API keys.
sections.changelog:
0.5.0

  • Hardened security for WordPress.org manual review compliance.
  • Renamed all prefixes to profitgate_ to ensure uniqueness.
  • Moved inline scripts and styles to external files for better security.
  • Optimized session handling using native WooCommerce sessions.
  • Implemented Transient-based shared secret for secure unauthenticated handshakes.
  • Improved nonce validation for standard and Block-based checkouts.

0.4.1

  • Hardened security for manual review.
  • Replaced direct error_log calls with WC_Logger.
  • Added nonce verification to the handshake process.
  • Cleaned up redundant nonce checks for WooCommerce Blocks.

0.4.0

  • Initial release of the production-ready WooCommerce Adapter.
  • Unified Domain architecture integration for improved performance.
  • Enhanced Checkout Gates for standard and Block-based checkouts.
